mentions.name: DC Flag Project
mentions.description: A neighborhood project the author is doing with his son, featuring a website built with Replit (the son completed the first 80%), flyers made using Gemini, and plans for the son to walk the neighborhood talking to neighbors.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm doing this with my son. Dcflagproject.com

Replit for the website (he did the first 80%), Gemini to make the flyers and he'll be walking the neighborhood and talking to neighbors.
